scripts.cf:migrate: npx --yes wrangler@4 d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.cf:migrate:local: npx --yes wrangler@4 d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.cf:dev: npm run build && npm run cf:migrate:local && npx --yes wrangler@4 dev
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run cf:migrate && npx --yes wrangler@4 deploy
